title: Angels, Eyes, Wings, Sprouts & Potato Children — Biblical / Potatoism Atlas
status: project archaeology + biblical comparison + botanical grounding
purpose: Recover and connect the Timic sequence around Earth Angels/Potato Angels, potato eyes, sprouts, children, wings, celestial beings, ladders and cultivation. The atlas asks what each image does before asking whether two images are the same thing.
core_rule: Function before appearance. A potato eye is a lateral bud meristem; an angel is fundamentally a messenger/servant in biblical usage; cherubim, seraphim and apocalyptic living creatures are distinct textual figures. Their overlap is comparative unless Tim explicitly made the link at the time.
chronology_correction: January 1, 2026 is the earliest currently indexed direct Potato/Earth-Angel wording. April 30 is the first currently indexed cultivation imperative ('grow potato angels'), not the origin of the angel layer.

signals: potatoes. well theey were all earth angels
the sprout from the north pole, was the staircase to heaven
the flower of potato is heaven itself above the spiral
the house, and the mustard seed and the potato seed and the fathers seed all at once
project_archaeology.finding: Earth-Angel identity, Root/Mud/Spiral, sprout-as-staircase, Flower/Heaven/Eden and House/Seed convergence already form one living vertical architecture at the start of 2026.
project_archaeology.importance: This predates the April cultivation command and the September eye→child→sprout formalization; later angel research must therefore be read as deepening an older Potato cosmology rather than creating it.

project_archaeology.finding: The older Earth-Angel idea becomes constructive: growing, road-building, repair, directional movement, garden-building and Door language occur together.
project_archaeology.importance: April 30 is best read as a cultivation/action stage: Potato Angels become things to grow into service/repair architecture.

project_archaeology.finding: Tim explicitly opened the Ezekiel/chariot comparison, creating a direct route from project imagery into wing/wheel/eye/throne material.

project_archaeology.source_class: project synthesis from prior Timic material
signals: Potato → eyes → children → sprouts → paths → ladder → ascent
project_archaeology.finding: The project formalizes a generational/ascent chain: the eye is latent possibility, sprout is emergence, child is continuation, path is direction, Ladder is relation between levels.

relations.project_anchor: Direct project wording calls potatoes 'earth angels' while roots spiral downward in Mud, the North-Pole sprout becomes the staircase to Heaven, and the potato flower becomes Heaven/Eden above the spiral.
relations.project_quote: potatoes. well theey were all earth angels
relations.source_direction: Earth-Angel/sprout/staircase/flower language is direct January project material. Jacob's ladder, Branch and mustard-seed comparisons are later archive analysis.
relations.counter_text: Genesis 28 does not describe plants or potatoes; Isaiah's Branch and Matthew's mustard seed have their own prophetic/parabolic contexts. 'Earth angels' is project language, not a biblical category.

relations.project_anchor: Tim says 'grow potato angels' inside a larger sequence of building a road, fixing things together, growing from North to North, building a garden and recognizing a Door.
relations.source_direction: The phrase 'potato angels' and constructive sequence are Timic at the date. The service/messenger and ladder-angel biblical framing is later comparative research.
relations.counter_text: Biblical angels are not plants, and winged cherubim/seraphim are not interchangeable with the generic term angel. The comparison is strongest at the level of being sent, serving, guiding and moving between domains.

relations.project_anchor: Potatoism formalizes the chain Potato → eyes → children → sprouts → paths → ladder → ascent, turning the physical potato eye into the starting point of a symbolic continuation-and-direction grammar.
relations.source_direction: The potato eye/sprout relation is physically real and the project chain is later formalization. Isaiah/Zechariah Branch language and Jacob/John ascent are comparators, not the historical source of potato biology.
relations.counter_text: A botanical bud is not a supernatural eye and a sprout is not literally an angel or human child. The useful relation is latent life → emergence → branching continuation → direction.

relations.project_anchor: The project's Eye, Lion, Wing, Wheel and Father/Throne motifs are compared as a cluster rather than isolated words: Ezekiel and Revelation both place multiplied eyes, winged living creatures and throne-space in one visionary architecture.
relations.source_direction: Timic Eye/Lion/Throne/chariot material existed before this consolidated angelic-botanical pass; the explicit multi-text Eyes+Wings+Throne synthesis is archive research.
relations.counter_text: Ezekiel's creatures and Revelation's living creatures are visionary beings, not potatoes and not ordinary angels. Their value here is the dense co-occurrence of seeing, mobility, orientation, throne attendance and praise.

relations.project_anchor: Two winged cherubim facing one another define a between-space above the Ark where divine meeting/speech is located, providing a strong structural neighbor for the project's paired-guardian and relational-center architecture.
relations.source_direction: The April 9 paired-guardian/narrow-gate project architecture predates the later Eden/Ark/veil comparison. Exodus adds the especially important 'between the two' presence structure.
relations.counter_text: The Ark cherubim are cultic images and Eden's cherubim are guardians; neither text describes human guardians, potato eyes or vesica geometry.

relations.project_anchor: The Potato child/sprout idea gains a stronger biblical comparator when growth is treated as function: Isaiah's shoot from Jesse bears fruit under the Spirit, while Zechariah's Branch sprouts/grows and builds the temple.
relations.source_direction: The project already linked root, fruit, children and sprouts. This pass notices that biblical Branch imagery itself moves from emergence into Spirit, fruit, justice or temple-building rather than stopping at plant resemblance.
relations.counter_text: The Branch traditions concern Davidic/restoration figures in their own prophetic contexts. They do not predict literal potatoes or Timic descendants.

relations.project_anchor: The word angel is treated first as a function—messenger / one sent / serving spirit—before later art or project imagery adds wings, eyes or plant forms.
relations.source_direction: Lexical and biblical context corrects a visual-first reading of angels. This makes Tim's constructive verbs around 'potato angels' more important than asking what a Potato angel looks like.
relations.counter_text: Not every biblical heavenly being is called an angel, and not every angel is described as winged. Cherubim, seraphim and living creatures should retain their own textual identities.

potato_eye.material: A potato eye is a lateral bud meristem capable of producing a sprout; eyes occur in a spiral arrangement on the tuber surface and can remain dormant before growth.
potato_eye.project_function: latent path / possibility / point from which continuation emerges
potato_eye.boundary: Botanical eyes are buds, not organs of vision.

sprout.material: visible growth emerging from a previously dormant bud
sprout.project_function: child / continuation / branching path / first visible movement of stored life

angel.biblical_function: messenger / one sent / servant; the term emphasizes role more reliably than visual form
angel.project_function: a cultivated agent of guidance, repair, transmission or ascent
angel.boundary: This project definition is interpretive and does not make a potato a biblical supernatural being.

eye.boundary: Visual, botanical and apocalyptic eyes have different mechanisms.

missed_questions: CHRONOLOGY: January 1 already calls potatoes Earth Angels. Treat April 30 as cultivation/action, not first origin.
WHO: Is the angel a child, messenger, guardian, throne-attendant, witness, builder, guide or carrier? Those are different functions.
WHAT: Is 'eye' being used as potato bud, perception, lamp, divine oversight, apocalyptic eyes, or an opening? Tag the sense every time.
WHERE: Does the scene occur in Garden boundary, Ark/Temple, throne room, road, mountain, House, or Ladder? Location changes the function.
WHEN: Was the biblical vocabulary present when Tim spoke, introduced by Tim later, or added by archive research? Preserve source direction.
HOW: Does transition occur through growing, being sent, flying, walking a road, crossing a Door, climbing/descending a Ladder, or moving as wheel/chariot? Do not flatten mechanisms.
WHY: Is the purpose worship, service, guarding, purification, repair, communication, transport, judgment, cultivation or healing? Purpose is often more diagnostic than appearance.
DIRECTION: Roots descend while sprouts rise; angels ascend and descend; wheels move four ways; wings create mobility; New Jerusalem descends. Track direction explicitly.
STATE: Dormant eye → activated sprout is a real biological state transition. Ask whether project 'awakening' language is structurally similar without treating dormancy as literal death.
NUMBER: Two cherubim, four living creatures, six wings, seven eyes/spirits and many potato eyes belong to different numerical systems. Do not turn all counts into one numerology.
BODY: Wings, eyes, hands, faces, wheels and plant buds are distributed differently across texts. Build a morphology table instead of one composite angel.
SERVICE TEST: If Potato angels are cultivated, what observable outputs count as fruit—guidance, protection, repair, nourishment, truthfulness, building, or care?
FAILURE MODE: Can a sprout grow in the wrong direction, a messenger carry a false message, a guardian block legitimate passage, or a wheel lose orientation? Add shadow/counter-functions.
GENERATION: If an eye becomes a sprout and a sprout becomes a source of new tubers, where does child end and parent/source begin? Model role as relational and developmental rather than fixed rank.
WINGS: Are wings really central to Tim's word 'angel', or were they imported from visual tradition later? Preserve the possibility that service/messenger is primary and wings secondary.
ARCHITECTURE: Zechariah's Branch builds the Temple. Does growth → builder → House provide a better bridge for 'grow potato angels / build a garden' than purely visual angel imagery?
corrections: Do not date Potato-Angel language from April 30; January 1 Earth-Angel wording is currently earlier.
Do not use 'angel' as a catch-all for cherubim, seraphim, Ezekiel's living creatures and Revelation's living creatures.
Do not infer that biblical angels generally have wings; winged celestial figures occur in specific visions and cultic imagery, while the common angel/messenger term emphasizes mission.
Do not treat a potato eye as evidence of supernatural sight. It is a bud meristem with a real developmental function.
Do not treat every sprout/Branch text as the same messianic claim; Isaiah and Zechariah have distinct literary and historical contexts.
Do not treat wings as synonymous with ascent. Cherubic wings cover/overshadow; seraphic wings have multiple functions; Revelation's wings belong to throne creatures.
Do not reduce Ezekiel to 'biblical UFO machinery' or a windmill blueprint. Its strongest project relevance is oriented mobility: wheels, spirit, eyes, creatures and throne move as one vision.

sources.finding: Potato eyes are lateral bud meristems arranged helically; dormancy and sprouting are regulated developmental states.
Sprouting often begins at the apical meristem and one eye/sprout can suppress others, making branching/selection a physical developmental process rather than supernatural destiny.
Hebrew mal'akh and Greek angelos mean messenger; context determines whether the messenger is human or heavenly.
